mentions.name: Coupling Cafe
mentions.description: Language learning app designed for couples, built so partners can learn each other's native languages; currently has a small number of paying users.
mentions.audience: Couples learning each other's native languages
mentions.source_excerpt: A language learning app for couples (https://couplingcafe.com). I wanted to learn my wife's native language, so I've been building this on my own for a long time and testing solutions! Just a few paying happy users.
